Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Physical page 55 prints the right-hand steering area as between 1 and 8 o'clock, mirroring the left-hand figure; this looks like a misprint, so the dossier does not teach it and holds it as typed debt [A03].
The basic grip on physical page 54 (7 to 9 and 3 to 5 o'clock) differs from the push/pull starting grip on page 55 (7 to 8 and 4 to 5 o'clock); both are reported exactly as printed [A02].
Page 57 recommends 12 o'clock only when backing to the left or right while turned in the seat, yet its backing steps place the left hand at 12 o'clock without that condition; the dossier reports both as printed [A05].
